schema_status.note: Machine-readable evidence manifest for the Layer 4 post-dispatch runtime gap delta. Records journal facts, hosted identity, and twelve post-dispatch gaps mapped to MANIFEST, TRUTH, VERIFY, and HOSTED tasks. Claims no hosted activation and no task completion. Delivered bytes are bound by content digest, not by a commit sha, and every claim about this cut -- in this manifest and in the document the digest binds -- is checked against the cut the manifest itself declares.

evidence_policy.mutation_rule: Task-scoped evidence changes require a Pantheon task commit and independent reviewer verification by Codex2. Any change to a bound artifact requires an evidence recut: a new delivery receipt commit carrying only the bound artifacts, green required checks on that receipt head, then an evidence-only commit that records the receipt. scripts/validate_twelve_loop_gap_evidence.py must return zero rejections over all ten rules before handoff, including receipt_commit_artifacts, which reads the receipt commit out of the local git object store; current_cut_consistency, which requires every enrolled claim about this cut to name this cut's version, canonical snapshot sequence, delivery receipt and rule count, or to mark the stale token (historical); and bound_document_consistency, which applies the same declared cut to the delta document the content digest binds.
